**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Read `options.retries`, new shape is `retryCount` | Accept both, throw a clear `TypeError` otherwise |
| [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Threw on `undefined` flag | Treat `undefined` as `false` |

The 8 warnings are still there. They are all `DEP` deprecation notices plus 3 lint warnings. None break the build. Say the word and I will clear those too.
